features: Unifies Holding and all other projector states behind the same live-display/feed.php iframe path
Removes the special direct Holding Screen renderer from live-display/index.php so every state change follows the same refresh mechanism
Live Display index now keeps one persistent iframe and reloads it with a changing state fingerprint when the server-confirmed projector state changes
live-display/feed.php now renders Holding Screen directly instead of returning HTTP 204
Remote projector still polls state every 700ms and supports automatic participant page rotation
Winner Podium, Final Ranking, Judges, Competitors, Scoring, Callbacks and Finalists remain session-driven through the same feed endpoint
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
